# anthropic_federation_rule (Resource)

Manage a workload identity federation rule enabled for one workspace. Requires an OAuth bearer token with `org:admin`; Admin API keys are not accepted. OAuth callers can manage only `workspace:developer` and `workspace:inference` rules. Bootstrap `org:admin` rules must be created in the Console. Destroy archives the rule. Multi-workspace and all-workspace targeting are not supported. Legacy rules without `workspace_ids` cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_service_account" "deploy" {
  name = "ci-deploy"
}

resource "anthropic_service_account_workspace_member" "deploy" {
  service_account_id = anthropic_service_account.deploy.id
  workspace_id       = "wrkspc_example"
  workspace_role     = "workspace_developer"
}

resource "anthropic_federation_issuer" "github" {
  name       = "github-actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
}

resource "anthropic_federation_rule" "deploy" {
  name               = "ci-deploy"
  issuer_id          = anthropic_federation_issuer.github.id
  service_account_id = anthropic_service_account.deploy.id
  workspace_id       = "wrkspc_example"
  oauth_scope        = "workspace:inference"
  match = {
    subject_prefix = "repo:example/app:ref:refs/heads/main"
  }
  depends_on = [anthropic_service_account_workspace_member.deploy]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the federation issuer. Changing it replaces the rule.
- `match` (Attributes) JWT constraints. Set a subject, claims or CEL condition; audience alone is insufficient. Shared issuers must constrain tenant identity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `name` (String) Unique slug identifier (lowercase, digits and hyphens).
- `oauth_scope` (String) OAuth scope granted by this rule.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the target service account, which must be a member of the workspace.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the single workspace enabled for this rule.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description. Removing it clears the description.
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Requested access-token lifetime in seconds, further capped by assertion validity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the federation rule.

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Exact audience match. Omit to use Anthropic's expected audience.
- `claims` (Map of String) Exact matches for top-level string claims.
- `condition` (String) CEL boolean expression over `claims`. Constant-true expressions are rejected by the API.
- `subject_prefix` (String) Exact subject match, or prefix match if ending in `*`. A wildcard-only subject is rejected.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_federation_rule.deploy fdrl_example
```
